The positive Rayleigh test vector (1,√q(1+s)) with s=√(m/(m−1)) cancels the a-coefficient at saturated core budget and proves μ≥1−s²/[1+q(1+s)²]. The chosen a*=s(1+s)/T,b*=(1−qa*)/(m−1) attain it while other spectrum remains within bounds; q=m−1 flips ordering of a*,b*. Independent direct stochastic-matrix eigenspectra for 64 (m,q) pairs and exact reduction of the published general corona formula matched. Finite spectra are diagnostic, not the universal proof.
